prefix_rule: Unique exact leading anchor prefix, length at least minimum_words minus one, three distinct words, no more than three anchor words remaining; optionally one proper partial next token. A later accepted ordinary candidate must contain the entire exact recent anchor in a newer callback over newer audio within the same segment and existing 12-second/12-update bounds.

preliminary_aborted_batch.reason: Additional segmented-transcript check found the new prefix path could re-acquire retained words from an older segment. Stop and preserve this version; constrain capture to current segment and rerun final frozen inputs.

saved_challenges.close_word_counter_basis: Historical strict-literal comparison. All five listed emissions are subsequently user-accepted under pod policy; see post_evaluation_pronunciation_review.

limits: All inputs are inspected regressions, not new held-out accuracy evidence.
Singapore adds one continuous classroom source, not an authored reading passage or multiple independent sources.
Existing shared audio is constructed from two adult TTS voices and two reused child recordings; not natural family/room audio.
The new evidence path requires exact complete anchor text and retains ordinary candidate filters; fuzzy and split routes remain unchanged.

Known close wrong-word false fires and ASR errors remain separate limitations. No word-latency score is claimed. The five reviewed close-word emissions were subsequently accepted by the user for the pod; retain the literal-word comparison separately.
A coached hibernate phrase contains the adult-spoken word; it is a positive shared-reading case, not a literal omission control.
Singapore utterance_01 remains unclear and utterance_02 remains an ASR miss; reaching utterance_03 can skip those earlier checkpoints.
Prefix-use counts include already-working checkpoints and are not a count of newly recovered effects.
